args.name: Preserve gathered roots
args.function: Provide a learnable practical method for reducing spoilage of gathered edible roots, with explicit material requirements and measurable preservation results.
args.conditions: I have three gathered roots. Their inventory record at tick 9 reports decay 5.28331244. Root nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 are known. I am outdoors in mild spring conditions; I have no preservation equipment. Local fallen branches are visible but not owned. No cooking ability appeared in the capability search.
args.inputs: Owned roots; other materials or equipment only if actually obtained. Suitable materials and processing method are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify feasible time, energy, materials, prerequisites, and any risks before use.
args.effects: Enable an actual preservation trial with observable spoilage outcomes and any nutritional or safety changes explicitly reported. Requesting or learning alone must not preserve food or create equipment.
